svg.title: The DSX Portfolio, by Brand
svg.desc: DSX Sim, DSX OS, DSX Exchange, DSX Flex, and DSX MaxLPS, each shown with what it covers. DSX OS and DSX Exchange are highlighted and labeled with an open-source component count: that is where the open-source components are concentrated.
